commercial_variant: SEAT León 5p 1.5 TSI (EcoTSI EVO) 96 kW / 130 CV Start&Stop Style, manual 6, Mk3 facelift (type 5F), MY2018 (IDAE labels MY19)

evidence.source: EEA CO2 cars 2018 final (discodata), MS=ES, Mk=SEAT, Ec=1498, Ft=Petrol, Status='F'
evidence.what_it_shows: The only 96 kW / 1498 cm3 type-5F rows with Cn 'LEON' (hatchback) are TAN e9*2007/46*0094 revisions *28-*31, Va BDACAX0V (2,340 registrations); 'LEON ST' is Va FDACAX0V. All BDACAX0V versions start 'FM6' (all manual; no DSG at 96 kW), M=1239 kg, and all carry both Enedc (111/113/116) and Ewltp (133-145), i.e. one WLTP-era homologation regime in 2018. Ve suffix LO51BA/LO51CA/LO51EB/LM51.. separates versions; nothing in EEA says which is Style.

evidence.source: IDAE base de datos, SEAT LEON (modelo 453), NEDC & WLTP listings and detail pages id 460838 ('SEAT LEON 1.5 EcoTSI 96kW (130cv) St&Sp STYLE') and 466104 ('… STYLE s48'), fetched via coches.idae.es/ajax
evidence.what_it_shows: Detail pages show name, segment, fuel, cc, manual gearbox, MTMA 1720/1780, power, WLTP consumption/CO2, dimensions 4282x1816x1459 and 5 seats, but NO código de tipo/variante/versión. These entries are WLTP (later MY) records; the MY19 row (111 g/km) exists only in the IDAE PDF guide (DC-09 S1), which has no type/version codes either. Record 460838 even shows 131 kW / 178 CV for a 96 kW name (IDAE data error, see DC-09 F6).

separate_technical_variants: Va BDACAX0V = León hatchback (Cn LEON) 96 kW manual; do NOT merge with Va FDACAX0V (LEON ST estate, M 1271 kg).
Va BDADAX0V = León 1.5 TSI 110 kW (150 CV), manual (Ve FM6S…) and DSG (Ve FD7S…) — different power and gearbox, exclude.
No 3-door (SC) 96 kW León rows found in ES 2018; no automatic 96 kW version exists in these rows.

Within BDACAX0V: Ve …LO51BA (Enedc 111, the value IDAE prints for 'STYLE MY19'), …LO51CA (113), …LO51EB (116) and …LM51CA/EB are distinct versions; the 111 g/km match with IDAE is numeric similarity only and does not establish the Style Ve.
TAN revisions *28, *29, *30, *31 share Va/Ve — revision number reflects extension date, not the commercial variant.
